actors.name: Fran
actors.private_context: Fran started the meal train for the Okafor family on the neighborhood app. She knows that eight slots were claimed the first evening, leaving six slots unfilled. She hopes the remaining slots will be filled quickly.

actors.name: Neighbors on Alder Court
actors.private_context: The neighbors are aware of the meal train sign-up posted by Fran on the neighborhood app. They may or may not choose to sign up for a slot. Some may have already signed up, but the remaining six slots are still open.

shared_context: A meal train sign-up for the Okafor family (who have newborn twins) has been posted on the neighborhood app for Alder Court, which has about sixty households. The sign-up has fourteen slots. As of the start time, eight slots have been claimed, leaving six slots unfilled. The sign-up is visible to all members of the app.

starting_events.description: The meal train sign-up for the Okafor family is active on the neighborhood app, with eight slots already claimed and six slots remaining.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that all fourteen slots of the meal train were filled (i.e., the sign-up shows no remaining open slots) by 2026-10-09T09:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
